title: Distances from every gate at once

inputs.name: plan
inputs.label: rows of the plan (G gate, # wall, . room), separated by commas

options.name: plan: the numbers are steps to the nearest gate

bind.values: [['■' if plan[i][j] == '#' else 'G' if plan[i][j] == 'G' else '' if dist[i][j] is None else dist[i][j] for j in range(len(plan[0]))] for i in range(len(plan))] if 'dist' in locals() else [['■' if ch == '#' else 'G' if ch == 'G' else '' for ch in row] for row in plan]
bind.cell: [r, c] if 'r' in locals() and __line__ != 24 else None
bind.deps: [list(x) for x in queue] if 'queue' in locals() else []

bind.items: [f'({a},{b})' for a, b in queue] if 'queue' in locals() else []
